title: What is our religion called?
intro: Our religion is Islam – and we are Muslims!

learn.html: Our religion is Islam. We are Muslims! We believe in Allah and in the Prophet Muhammad (SAW), we tell the truth and we do good deeds.

Islam is my religion,
Islam is my safety,
Islam teaches me
to love all of you.

Islam asks for effort,
for learning and for work,
Islam does not want lies –
believe while you are young.
(English translation)
learn.bs:
Islam mi je vjera,
islam mi je spas,
islam mene uči
da volim sve vas.

Islam žrtvu traži,
nauku i rad,
islam neće laži –
vjeruj dok si mlad.
(Suada Hastor)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Islam is the religion that Allah, the Most High, revealed through His prophets to all of humankind.

practice.title: What does Islam teach us?
practice.prompt: Tap everything Islam teaches us, then tap Check.

options.why: Islam does not want lies – a Muslim tells the truth.
Islam teaches us to love others and be kind.

questions.q: What do we call the people who follow Islam?
